# surface: help__cards
# argv: sila cards --help

--- stdout ---
sila cards  -  inspect typed session cards written at session end

Usage
  sila cards list [--limit=N]
  sila cards show <card-id|session-id>

Options
  --json                   Emit machine-readable JSON on stdout
  --db=<path>              Knowledge store path
